description: This file contains a report module for 'Applicant Wise Loan Security Exposure' in the ERPNext system, including functions to fetch and process loan security data, generate report columns, and calculate applicant-specific loan security details.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate report columns and data based on filters.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the structure and labels of the report columns.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Fetches and compiles the report data based on filters.

methods.name: get_loan_security_details
methods.description: Retrieves latest loan security prices and details.

methods.name: get_applicant_wise_total_loan_security_qty
methods.description: Calculates total pledged and unpledged loan security quantities per applicant.
